Comment 0 (2010-03-16): What steps will reproduce the problem? 1. Compile following code: // ==ClosureCompiler== // @output_file_name default.js // @compilation_level ADVANCED_OPTIMIZATIONS // ==/ClosureCompiler== var t = null; window.test = function() { if (t != null) { t = null; } t = 1; }; What is the expected output? What do you see instead? Code should be compiled without warnings, but I see "JSC_DETERMINISTIC_TEST: condition always evaluates to false".
Comment 1 (2010-03-16): thanks for the report. the immediate work around is to have a @type {?number} annotation on the global variable.
Comment 2 (2010-03-18): This issue was closed by revision r142.
